messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Change structure plot colors
parts:
Hi Laia,

Please find below some example code to change the colors of the PCoA plot.

Changing the colors of the structure plot is not ready yet, but we are working on this option, and other options to customise the plot. Hopefully, we will have ready these options at the beginning of the next week.

Cheers,
Luis

library(dartR)
pcoa <- gl.pcoa(platypus.gl)
plot_colors <- gl.select.colors(x=platypus.gl,library='baseR',palette='rainbow')
plot_pcoa <- gl.pcoa.plot(pcoa,platypus.gl,pt.colors = plot_colors)
